metadata.title: Google Earnings Could be a Bad Omen for Big Tech Stocks<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Google’s Earnings Could be a Bad Omen for Big Tech
The selloff in Alphabet shares is the latest indication that Wall Street’s concerns about heavy artificial-intelligence spending are mounting, and it spells trouble for other tech companies as they report earnings.
